#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    unsigned cp = 0x6613;                           // 易

    unsigned char b1 = 0xE0 | (cp >> 12);           // first byte
    unsigned char b2 = 0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3F);   // middle byte
    unsigned char b3 = 0x80 | (cp & 0x3F);          // last byte

    printf("U+%04X -> %02X %02X %02X\n", cp, b1, b2, b3);
    printf("decimal:   %d %d %d\n", b1, b2, b3);

    // send the three bytes to the terminal; it decodes them as UTF-8
    char s[] = { b1, b2, b3, '\0' };
    printf("printed:   %s\n", s);
    return 0;
}
